children: Flux Power entered into Amendment No. 7 to its Loan and Security Agreement with Gibraltar Business Capital on Sep 17 2026. The amendment adds covenants requiring an equity raise of at least $4.0 million within 50 days and tighter budget and reporting obligations, with material deviations constituting default. The company remains in default, with Gibraltar permitting continued access to the revolving credit facility but reserving the right to terminate access and accelerate obligations. Flux Power will pay a $135,000 amendment fee in three monthly installments.
: Amendment No. 7 to Loan and Security Agreement (revolving credit facility)
: Amend credit terms and maintain liquidity amid default
